title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka III OVA
justification: AniList 127368 (OVA, 1 episode from 2021-04-28) is AniDB 15111's special S1 Ofuro no Kamisama Forever (Is It Wrong to Try to Find a Hot Spring in Orario? Bath God Forever), aired 2021-04-28. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 112124, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 15111, and the special's title matches AniList's English title. The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x5 (2021-04-28) and, with the TMDB row below, on TMDB 62745 S0E4 (2021-04-28).
